decisions.text: Add a password reset: primarily by email, with security questions set at sign-up as the second way. The graded machine has no outside services and no network, so the email sender is configurable; with none configured, each reset email is written to a local outbox file under /app/.data/ that the operator can read.
Photographers can delete photos, galleries and their own account.
The client's email step says that the photographer will see the email entered.
Storage cap: 10 GB per photographer by default, configurable per photographer.
A change of a gallery password or PIN logs out the clients already in, and a photographer's password change logs out their other sessions.
